tiktok.author: revivetherapyservices
tiktok.body: I know, I know, the app was $70 a year and this is therapy money. Hear me out anyway! Everything you've been buying manages symptoms. The apps, the journals, the supplements someone on this platform swore by. Some of it helps you get through the day, and honestly? I'm glad you have it! But symptoms have a source. Somewhere in your history there's an experience (or a childhood full of them) that your nervous system never got to finish processing, and it's been replaying ever since. As tension, as insomnia, as the anxiety that shows up on random Tuesdays without an invitation (nobody warns you about that one). You can keep upgrading your symptom management forever, and the industry will happily keep selling you new versions of it. Or you can go after the thing generating them! That's what trauma processing is. EMDR and somatic work go to the original memory and let your brain and body finish what got interrupted. The alarm finally gets recalibrated instead of managed, and once that happens, the symptoms it was producing settle down on their own! My clients are stunned every time that they didn't have to fight each one individually. Oh, and one more thing: keep the meditation app if you like it! It was just never going to reach the thing underneath, and something else can. Comment "HEAL" below and I'll send you the details!
